title: The Truth of the Shackles
next_chapter_hook: A hoarse voice echoed from the depths of the Tianji Record—that was his father's final consciousness fragment before death—'Find the fourth page, that is the key to breaking the situation'

text.content:
The Holy Sect Elder's words struck Chen Ji's heart like a heavy hammer. The word 'trash' he had heard for seventeen years had long numbed him, but hearing it from this old bastard now carried an insufferable smugness.

Chen Ji did not speak. He slowly raised his head, his pitch-black eyes containing no anger, no fear—only an almost icy calm. That calm unsettled the Holy Sect Elder far more than any rage would.

Just then, the shackle mark on his chest suddenly burned white-hot.

It was a soul-searing agony, as if something within him was awakening. Chen Ji clutched his chest, veins bulging on his forehead, sweat trickling down his temples. He could feel that the shackle that had imprisoned him for seventeen years was undergoing some terrible transformation.

"What? The shackle is rebelling?" The Holy Sect Eldersneered一声，"trash就是trash，连自己的力量都承受不住。不过这样也好，省得老夫动手——"

话话音未落，他的声音戛然而止。

Because Chen Ji slowly straightened up, and from the shackle mark on his chest, a golden light was emerging.

The Tianji Record quivered violently in the Sea of Heavenly Secrets.

Chen Ji closed his eyes, yet he could still 'see'—countless tiny runes were pouring out from the shackle mark onto the cover of the Tianji Record, intertwining in the air to form a complete pattern. The pattern was extremely complex, every line containing the supreme principles of the Dao, making one's head throb merely from gazing upon it.

"This is..." Chen Ji gasped.

He recognized this pattern.

Because it was identical to the shackle mark on his chest. No, wait—the shackle mark was only one-third of this complete pattern! The remaining two-thirds had been sealed within the Tianji Record, never revealing themselves.

The Shackle and the Tianji Record were two parts of the same existence.

The Holy Sect Elder's expression finally changed.

"Impossible!" he shouted, "The complete seal of the Tianji Record has never been activated! How could a piece of trash like you—"

"How?" Chen Ji suddenly smiled, that smile ice-cold and biting, "Because I am the son of Chen Xuan."

dialogue.content:
At that very moment, a genderless will descended.

It was not the Holy Sect Elder's aura, but a presence from a higher dimension—the Eye of Heavenly Will.

Its voice resounded directly in Chen Ji's mind, calm as an ancient well, devoid of any emotion: "You have finally reached this point, the abandoned son of the Chen family."

text.content:
Chen Ji shuddered.

The Eye of Heavenly Will—the ultimate existence that would only officially appear in Volume 8—was actually conversing with him prematurely. What did this mean? Was every step he took within its calculations?

"Do you think obtaining the Tianji Record was coincidence?" the Eye of Heavenly Will continued, "Do you think your father's death was an accident?"

Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply.

"Chen Xuan was the only Tianji Record master in history who attempted to resist me." The Eye of Heavenly Will's voice was terrifyingly calm, "So I needed a chess piece to continue this line after his death. You, Chen Ji, from the moment of your birth, existed solely to inherit his shackles."

Chen Ji felt his blood freeze.

He had always thought he was defying fate, scheming across the world. But in the end, everything he had done—cultivating the Tianji Record, plotting against the three great sects, resisting the demonic path invasion—was merely the necessary progression on the Eye of Heavenly Will's chessboard.

He was not a chess player. From beginning to end, he was a manipulated chess piece.

dialogue.content:
"Father..." Chen Ji murmured softly, his voice hoarse, "He knew all this, so that's why he died?"

"Smart." The Eye of Heavenly Will replied, "He discovered the truth and tried to break the game. So I had the Holy Sect Elder 'accidentally' kill him, and conveniently raised you into a new chess piece."

text.content:
Chen Ji felt his world collapsing.

Seventeen years of endurance, seventeen years of scheming, seventeen years of playing the pig to eat the tiger—turns out from the very beginning, his 'endurance' was designed, his 'scheming' was merely the progression of the game, his 'playing the pig' was the entertainment the Eye of Heavenly Will loved to watch.

So who was he? What was the meaning of his existence?

Just as Chen Ji was nearly crushed by this despair, the Tianji Record suddenly sent a warm current of power.

That was Mo Xiansheng's voice—or rather, the final remnant of his father's will.

"Child, everything you heard is true. But don't forget—" the voice was faint yet firm, "The chessboard is dead, but the pieces are alive."

Chen Ji opened his eyes sharply.

Yes, the chessboard is dead, but the pieces are alive.

The Eye of Heavenly Will could foresee all his actions, but it could not foresee what choices a truly 'awakened' piece would make. Because even it didn't know—when the pieces begin to think, where will the game go?

"I have a question." Chen Ji suddenly spoke, his voice regaining its composure.

"Ask." The Eye of Heavenly Will seemed intrigued.

"If I die here right now, what happens to the game?"

The air suddenly solidified.

The Holy Sect Elder froze—he never expected this trash to actually threaten with his own death. And the Eye of Heavenly Will's will also fell silent for an instant—an extremely brief moment, so short as to barely exist.

But Chen Ji caught it.

Chen Ji smiled.

It was a relieved yet slightly manic smile.

"I see. You need me alive, otherwise you wouldn't have appeared prematurely." A flash of understanding appeared in his eyes, "The conditions for the union of Shackle and Tianji Record haven't been met yet, so you need me to continue moving forward."

dialogue.content:
The Eye of Heavenly Will fell silent for a moment.

"Interesting." It said, "But do you think knowing this changes anything? No matter how precise the chessboard, it merely makes you take a few more steps."

"Is that so?" Chen Ji countered, "Then why did you tell me the truth?"

text.content:
This time, the Eye of Heavenly Will did not answer.

Its will slowly receded, as if it had never appeared. But in that final moment, Chen Ji sensed a strange emotional fluctuation—it seemed like... wariness?

No, impossible. How could the Eye of Heavenly Will be wary of a chess piece?

But if not wariness, how else to explain its premature appearance and proactive revelation of the truth?

The Holy Sect Elder's expression turned extremely ugly.

He couldn't understand the dialogue between Chen Ji and the Eye of Heavenly Will, but he could feel that genderless will had descended. Now that the Eye of Heavenly Will had left, facing Chen Ji alone, he suddenly felt uneasy.

"Trash, are you putting on an act?!" he barked with more bravado than courage, "Today, you won't leave here alive—"

choice.prompt: Faced with the Holy Sect Elder's threat, Chen Ji needed to make a choice. The truth of the shackles had just been revealed, his worldview was crumbling, but the enemy was right before his eyes.

choices.description: Digest the information revealed by the Eye of Heavenly Will, endure silently, save it for future scheming. Forcefully confronting the Holy Sect Elder was not a wise move.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain key intelligence, lay the groundwork for a later counterattack
choices.risk_hint: May be pursued by the Elder, falling into danger

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, suppressing all his anger and despair. He knew this was not the time for revenge. Since the Eye of Heavenly Will was watching in the shadows, he would act out a play—a play that even the Eye of Heavenly Will couldn't see through.

dialogue.content:
"The Elder is right." Chen Ji lowered his head, his voice returning to its usual timidity, "I'm just trash, how dare I oppose the Elder."

He turned to leave, but in that moment of turning, a faint, almost imperceptible cold smile curved his lips.

choices.description: Since the Eye of Heavenly Will needs him alive, that means he has bargaining chips right now. The Holy Sect Elder is merely a chess piece—he will force the mastermind behind the scenes to enter the game personally.
choices.visible_cost: Exposing part of his strength may draw bigger troubles
choices.visible_reward: Shake the Holy Sect Elder, display his true power

text.content:
Chen Ji stopped his footsteps and slowly turned around.

His eyes had changed—no longer that cringing trash, but a revenger returning from hell. The shackle mark on his chest and the Tianji Record runes intertwined and resonated, emitting a heart-stopping radiance.

dialogue.content:
"Elder, do you know why the Eye of Heavenly Will appeared prematurely?" Chen Ji's voice was terrifyingly calm, "Because it needs me alive. And you, are merely an abandoned piece it used to test me."

He raised his hand, and the Tianji Record coalesced into a sword in his palm.

"Now, let us discuss—who is the real trash."

text.content:
Just then, a faint voice echoed from the depths of the Tianji Record.

The voice was hoarse and familiar; Chen Ji's heart lurched—it was his father's voice!

"Ji'er... find the fourth page... key to breaking the situation..."

The voice came in fragments, like a candle flame in the wind, about to extinguish at any moment. But those final words struck like thunder in Chen Ji's mind.

The fourth page.

The Tianji Record currently only had three pages of fragmentary records; the third page contained Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul. But father said there was a fourth page—one that even the Tianji Record itself had no record of, a deliberately sealed forbidden ground.

Why would his father's consciousness fragment before death be preserved within the Tianji Record? What had he seen before his death?

Chen Ji closed his eyes, forcibly suppressing the surge of grief.

Father had been dead for seventeen years, yet his consciousness remained within the Tianji Record, solely to tell him these words at this critical moment. What did this mean? It meant father had long foreseen this day and secretly laid plans for him.

He was not alone. From beginning to end, he was never alone.

Even if the Eye of Heavenly Will was the ultimate antagonist, even if the entire world was a chessboard, his father had long placed a key outside the game for him.

Chen Ji opened his eyes.

His gaze toward the Holy Sect Elder no longer held the previous anger and despair. Instead, there was an almost reverent calm.

"Elder, I suddenly remembered something." he said.

"What?"

"My father, before he died, seemed to have said the same thing—'trash'." Chen Ji smiled faintly, that smile sending a chill down the Holy Sect Elder's spine, "I wonder, what was his expression at that time?"

The Holy Sect Elder's pupils contracted sharply.

Chen Xuan's expression before death—of course he remembered. It was not fear, not rage, but an eerie calm, as if he were looking at a dead person.

At the time, he thought it was forced composure, but now looking back...

"What are you trying to say?!" The Holy Sect Elder barked, his voice already trembling.

"Nothing." Chen Ji shook his head, "I just wanted to tell the Elder that before my father died, he glanced at you. That gaze, I remember it to this day."

He paused, his voice low:

"He said then—'You won't survive this year.'"

The air solidified instantly.

The Holy Sect Elder's face turned ashen; a chill climbed from the soles of his feet to the crown of his head. He wanted to retort, but his throat felt blocked by something, unable to utter a single word.

Chen Ji no longer looked at him, turning and walking into the darkness.

The resonance between Shackle and Tianji Record gradually subsided, but that soul-searing agony was deeply etched in his memory. He knew the shackle on his body was loosening, the Eye of Heavenly Will's control over him weakening—but this didn't mean he was safe.

On the contrary, a greater storm was approaching.

Because from this moment on, he was no longer a chess piece on the Eye of Heavenly Will's board. He would become the one who plays the game.

After Chen Ji departed, the Holy Sect Elder stood alone, unable to move for a long time.

"You won't survive this year"—Chen Xuan's words before death were like a poisoned thorn, deeply embedded in his heart. He didn't believe it, of course not. Chen Xuan had been dead for seventeen years, and he was still alive and well.

But...

Why did that trash Chen Ji know these words?

Why were his voice, his eyes, so similar to Chen Xuan's back then?

The Holy Sect Elder suddenly felt a bone-deep fear. He raised his head, gazing at the void above, as if an invisible eye were watching from there.

The Eye of Heavenly Will.

It was still watching.

Meanwhile, Chen Ji had already walked several miles away.

He leaned against a withered tree, gasping heavily. The prior dialogue with the Eye of Heavenly Will had consumed too much of his energy, and the resonance between Shackle and Tianji Record made his head throb agonizingly.

But his eyes were clearer than ever.

The Shackle and Tianji Record were two parts of the same existence. Father's death was not an accident, but a deliberate arrangement by the Eye of Heavenly Will. From the moment of his birth, he was a carefully cultivated chess piece.

These truths were enough to break anyone.

But Chen Ji would not break.

Because he never believed in fate.

For seventeen years, he walked the world as a 'trash,' secretly plotting across the realm, appearing to drift with the current while every step was within his own calculations. The Eye of Heavenly Will thought it was the chess player, thought everything was under control—but it forgot one thing.

When the game reaches mid-board, the weight of each piece changes.

And he, Chen Ji, was never an ordinary piece.

He was the one who would flip the entire board.

Beneath the withered tree, moonlight scattered.

Chen Ji slowly spread his palm; the Tianji Record floated above it, emanating a soft glow. He gazed at the damaged cover, complex emotions welling in his heart.

Father, what did you see? What secrets does the fourth page hold?

The Tianji Record gave no answer. But at the corner of the cover, an extremely faint rune was slowly emerging—the proof of the fourth page's existence.

Chen Ji took a deep breath and stored the Tianji Record within his body.

There was still a long road ahead, but he was no longer lost.

Because he finally understood why he was born.

Born to break the shackles.

Born to flip the board.

Born to seek revenge.

The night deepened; in the distance, wild wolves howled.

Chen Ji stood up and cast one final glance toward where the Holy Sect Elder had been. There, the will of the Eye of Heavenly Will was watching everything, watching its chess pieces advance step by step according to its script.

But what it didn't know—

One piece had already awakened.

In the depths of the Tianji Record, the father's residual consciousness fragment trembled slightly, as if responding to Chen Ji's resolve. And within that tremor, a hoarse voice sounded one final time:

"Ji'er... I'll be waiting for you... on the fourth page..."

The voice dissipated in the night wind, as if it had never existed.

But Chen Ji knew it was no illusion.

Father had been waiting for him all along.
